source_note: CORRECTED 2026-10-06: the previous file carried segment-note columns as if they were group totals (FY2025 total assets 3,208,709 and FY2024 80,378 were columns of the segment reconciliation, not the group statement of financial position). Replaced with the audited group figures from the consolidated statement of financial position, page 27 to 28, and the segment reconciliation on page 55, both of which print group total assets 3,628,389 for 2025 and 3,106,287 for 2024. The three older columns (FY2023, FY2022, FY2021) held the same segment columns and were dropped rather than carried, because no audited group figure was available to replace them. Units N'000. Non-current assets plus current assets equals total assets, non-current plus current liabilities equals total liabilities, and liabilities plus equity equals total assets, exactly, on both periods.
